description: Source code implementing Vulkan-based upsampling operations (nearest and bilinear) for tensors in PyTorch, including function definitions, kernel submissions, and library registration.

methods.name: upsample_nearest2d
methods.description: Performs nearest neighbor upsampling on a 4D tensor using Vulkan compute shaders.

methods.name: upsample_bilinear2d
methods.description: Performs bilinear upsampling on a 4D tensor with optional align_corners parameter using Vulkan compute shaders.
